title: Discord Join Call
blurb: A friendly two-note rise, and somebody has entered the call. An entire generation is now conditioned to respond to the Discord join blip by saying a name as a question, before the person has spoken a word. It ranks among the most-heard sounds in modern online socialising, so it lands beautifully out of context: play it mid-conversation and watch everyone glance at their taskbar. Use it in edits to signal an arrival. Use it in a real call to convince the group that a ghost member has just materialised.
